# Future Ammunition - MCC

`jmfsb_fa_mcc`

Future Ammunition in the MCC rifles' own magazines - every PMAG, EMAG, USGI, HK, L5 and TTI look MCC ships, filled with each FA round of its calibre (5.56, .300 BLK, 7.62x39, 5.45, and the 6.8 SPC, 6 ARC and 6.5x43 rounds made for it in fa_extracal), plain and in every tracer colour, and put in the same wells. Generated by `tools/gen_fa_mcc.py`. Loads only with MCC.

## Requires

- `cba_main` _(external)_
- `ace_ballistics` _(external)_
- `jmfsb_fa_ammo`
- `jmfsb_fa_extracal`
- `MCC_Core` _(external)_

Carries `skipWhenMissingDependencies` - the PBO is skipped rather than breaking the load order when something above is absent.
